technical_analysis.tip: Support aur Resistance levels ko hamesha higher timeframes (Daily, Weekly) par mark karein. Chote timeframes par fake breakouts hote hain.
Jab price 200 EMA ke upar ho, toh sirf BUY setups dhoondein. Jab neeche ho, toh sirf SELL setups. Trend ke against kabhi trade na karein.
RSI divergence ek powerful reversal signal hai. Agar price naya high bana raha hai lekin RSI naya high nahi bana raha, toh reversal aa sakta hai.
MACD crossover tab zyada reliable hota hai jab woh zero line ke upar ya neeche ho. Flat market mein MACD fake signals deta hai.
Candlestick patterns sirf key levels (Support/Resistance) par kaam karte hain. Middle of nowhere mein woh bekaar hain.
Bollinger Bands jab squeeze ho jayein (patli ho jayein), toh bara move aane wala hota hai. Direction ka pata nahi hota, isliye breakout ka intezar karein.
Volume hamesha confirm karta hai. Agar price barh raha hai lekin volume nahi, toh woh move fake hai.
Fibonacci retracement 0.618 aur 0.5 levels sabse zyada respected hote hain. Entry ke liye in levels ka intezar karein.

fundamental_analysis.tip: FOMC Statement ke din kabhi trade na karein. Market 200-300 pips tak achanak move kar sakta hai. Pehle 15 minute ka intezar karein.
NFP (Non-Farm Payroll) hamesha month ke pehle Friday ko aata hai. Us din high volatility expected hoti hai.
Central bank ke interest rate decisions market ka sabse bara driver hote hain. Hawkish (rate hike) = currency strong. Dovish (rate cut) = currency weak.
CPI (Inflation) data 3:30 PM PKT par aata hai. Agar forecast se zyada aaye toh currency strong hoti hai, kyunke rate hike expected hoti hai.
Economic calendar hamesha trade se pehle check karein. High impact news ke 30 minute pehle aur baad tak koi position na lein.
DXY (Dollar Index) aur Gold ka inverse relationship hota hai. Jab DXY upar jata hai, Gold neeche aata hai.
Geopolitical events (wars, elections) market mein uncertainty paida karte hain. Aise waqt mein safe-haven assets (Gold, JPY, USD) demand mein aate hain.

risk_management.tip: Ek trade mein apne account ka sirf 1-2% risk karein. Agar account $1000 hai, toh maximum $10-20 ka loss acceptable hai.
Stop Loss hamesha lagayein — chahe aap kitne bhi confident hon. Ek trade poora account khatam kar sakti hai.
Risk/Reward Ratio kam se kam 1:2 rakhein. Matlab agar aap $10 risk kar rahe hain, toh $20 profit ka target rakhein.
Ek din mein 3 se zyada losing trades ke baad trading band kar dein. Aapka mind frustrated ho jata hai aur ghalat decisions leta hai.
Position size hamesha Stop Loss ki width ke hisaab se calculate karein, apni feelings ke hisaab se nahi.
Leverage ek double-edged sword hai. 1:100 leverage ka matlab hai ke 1% move aapka poora account kha sakta hai.
Trading se pehle apna daily loss limit set karein. Agar woh hit ho jaye, toh laptop band karein aur kal wapas aayein.

trading_psychology.tip: Revenge trading sab se bara account killer hai. Loss ke baad foran wapas trade karne ki koshish na karein.
FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) aapko galat waqt par trade karwata hai. Agar setup nikal gaya, toh agla intezar karein.
Ek acha trader 100 trades mein 40 jeet kar bhi profit kamata hai — agar uski Risk/Reward sahi ho.
Trading ek marathon hai, sprint nahi. Overnight rich banne ki koshish aapko overnight poor bana degi.
Apni trades ka journal rakhein. Har entry ka reason likhein. 1 mahine baad aap apni ghaltiyan khud dekh payenge.
Greed aur Fear — yeh do emotions hain jo traders ko barbaad karte hain. Inhe control karna seekhein.
Kabhi bhi apna loss recover karne ke liye position size na barhayein. Yeh gambling hai, trading nahi.

market_wisdom.tip: "Trend is your friend" — jab tak trend na toote, uske against trade na karein.
"Buy the rumor, sell the news" — market expectation par chalta hai, actual news par nahi.
"Cut your losses short, let your profits run" — yeh trading ka golden rule hai.
"The market can stay irrational longer than you can stay solvent" — kabhi bhi market ke against stubborn na banein.
"Plan the trade, trade the plan" — bina plan ke trade karna casino mein paisa lagane ke barabar hai.
Market 80% waqt range mein hota hai aur 20% waqt trend karta hai. Patience rakhein.
